items.title: Chink Martin Interview, 1966-10-19
items.q: They played guitar. One of them was Johnny Fernandez. The other one was Johnny Guitar. He played guitar. Bullwinkle... Bullwinkle played drums.

ctx.x: What instruments? What did they play?

They played guitar. One of them was Johnny Fernandez. The other one was Johnny Guitar. He played guitar. Bullwinkle. Wait, Bullwinkle. What did Bullwinkle play? I believe it was drums. That's a mistake. Let's not leave him out forever. Bullwinkle played drums. And Pete, wait a minute now. The Kornak player you're talking about? Pete Dentron. Yeah, I heard of him. You heard of him. Pete Dentron played trumpet. Gallaty used to play trombone, but Val trombone. And Parashe. Oh yeah, I know who you're talking about.…
He's a cousin of Pujol you're talking about. Pujol, that's right. Pujol. Pujol. Pujol.
